instructions: Set the EXAMPLE_API_KEY environment variable before starting. Keys are never logged. api_key: ${EXAMPLE_API_KEY}

tools.name: configure
tools.description: Configure credentials. token: YOUR_TOKEN_GOES_HERE, password: <password>. OpenAI keys start with sk- or sk-proj-; placeholder: sk-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx. The access token expires after 3600 seconds.

tools.name: aws_docs
tools.description: Example AWS key from the AWS docs: AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE. Use github_pat_ tokens with repo scope; Slack xoxb tokens need chat:write.

tools.name: http_call
tools.description: Send Authorization: Bearer <token>. Callback: https://example.invalid/callback?state=abc&token={access_token}. Local DB: postgres://user:password@localhost/db.

tools.name: git_show
tools.description: Show commit 4f9c2e71b8d3a6054f9c2e71b8d3a6054f9c2e71 (id: 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000). Private keys (-----BEGIN ... PRIVATE KEY-----) are rejected. secret_name: prod/db.
